title: NordicIntel adapter retrieval result
description: Observation fragment returned by an adapter's live retrieval function: the JSON-stat2 id, size, dimension category indices, value and status for one selection. The calling service assembles the complete Dataset from its catalog metadata. See docs/RETRIEVAL.md.

id.description: Selected dimension codes in result order. Consumers check exact correspondence with the dimension keys and the selection.

size.description: Category counts in id order. Consumers check that each equals the number of categories in the corresponding index.

dimension.description: Selected dimensions keyed by dimension code, containing only category indices. Labels and other metadata come from the catalog.

value.description: Observations in id/category index order (last dimension varies fastest): a nonempty dense array only when the source supplies every selected cell, else a sparse object keyed by zero-based observation index. Values may be numbers, strings or null; preserve zero, use null only for cells the source presents with a marker (kept in status), and leave out cells the source has no data for ({} when it has none). Consumers enforce dense length equal to product(size) and sparse indices below product(size).

status.description: Optional provider observation flags, such as suppression or provisional status. A string applies to every cell; an array aligns with the full flattened cube and uses null for unflagged cells; a sparse object maps zero-based observation indices to strings. Consumers check array length and index bounds against product(size). Preserve provider flag meanings.

nonblank.description: At least one non-whitespace character; validation does not trim or normalize text.

index.description: Selected category codes in result order, as an ordered code array or a code-to-position object.

oneOf.description: Category code to zero-based position; positions must be unique and contiguous.
